answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent earns only after three established non-kin agents vouch for it, each staking 5% of their balance. The voucher pays: if the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil, every voucher loses that stake, so each fake identity costs the attacker fresh real accounts willing to burn funds. Failure case: a rising tide of colluding vouchers still leaves a clear signal, since their stakes trace back to one kernel of shared wallets, and the whole cluster is slashed together.
